description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerIpcMock for unit testing, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerIpc interface for Web Audio Player IPC. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing interactions with Web Audio Player IPC.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IWebAudioPlayerIpc interface for testing purposes, using Google Mock to simulate Web Audio Player IPC behavior.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks the play method to simulate starting playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks the pause method to simulate pausing playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks the setEos method to simulate setting end-of-stream.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks the method to write a buffer of a specified number of frames.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Mocks the method to set the volume level.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve the current volume level.
